task: ae.locks hierarchical lock manager with deadlock detection
reasoning_summary: Designed a non-blocking lock manager so every schedule is deterministic: acquire returns GRANTED/WAITING/ABORTED plus an events record of woken and aborted transactions. Multi-step acquire plans (intention locks then the target) resume on grant, and every operation ends with a wait-for-graph cycle search whose edges include earlier incompatible queue entries; the youngest txn in a cycle is aborted. Tests combine literal tables, scenarios, seeded simulations with an invariant checker and an independent blocked-set model, and five mutants of the engine were each killed.
